topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include spatial separation via analog beamforming, polarization diversity, adaptive frequency reuse, HARQ, RSMA, and machine learning-based interference prediction. These methods mitigate co-channel interference, enhancing spectral efficiency and reliability. Integrating NOMA and edge computing further optimizes resource allocation and reduces latency.
